Current year Income Certificate with family income < ₹8 lakh (for Covid-martyred parents and forces wards categories)

scheme.name: PM-YASASVI: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
scheme.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
scheme.amount: ₹20,000/year (Group 1 - Degree/PG Professional: ₹10,000 academic allowance + ₹10,000 tuition fee); ₹13,000/year (Group 2 - Other Professional: ₹8,000 + ₹5,000); ₹8,000/year (Group 3 - Graduate/PG: ₹6,000 + ₹2,000); ₹5,000/year (Group 4 - Post-matric non-degree: ₹5,000 + ₹0)

states: All India (applies to all States/UTs; scholarship awarded by the State to which the applicant belongs - permanently settled)
eligibility.gender: All (restriction: only two boys per family eligible; no restriction for girls)
eligibility.years_of_study: Up to the completion of the course
eligibility.income_limit: ₹2.50 lakhs per annum (annual family income of parents/guardians)

documents_required: Valid Income certificate issued by the competent Authority
Caste/Community Certificate issued by the competent authority
scheme.how_to_apply: Register/login on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or respective State/UT scholarship portal, fill the application form, upload required documents, and submit before 30th June each year.
scheme.notes: Centrally Sponsored Scheme under Samagra Shiksha. Restriction: Only two boys per family can receive the scholarship; no limit on girls. Freeship Card provided for tuition/hostel fee reimbursement. Application portal opens 1st April and closes 30th June. Students belonging to one State but studying in another receive scholarship from their home State. Correspondence/online students eligible for tuition fees but not academic allowance. Course renewal available for illness or failure in Group I exams. Cannot avail simultaneously with other similar scholarships.

reasons: Family income ₹1.8L is within the ₹2.5L limit
blockers: Only for OBC category (you are SC)
cautions: Deadline has passed — watch for the next cycle

event.name: Post Matric Scholarships to the students belonging of Scheduled Castes for studies in India (PMS-SC)

scheme.name: Post Matric Scholarships to the students belonging of Scheduled Castes for studies in India (PMS-SC)
scheme.provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
scheme.amount: Compulsory non-refundable fees (tuition etc.) as fixed by State Fee Fixation/Rationalization Committee + Academic allowance (yearly): Group 1 (professional degree/PG): Hostellers Rs.13,500 / Day Scholars Rs.7,000; Group 2 (other professional courses): Hostellers Rs.9,500 / Day Scholars Rs.6,500; Group 3 (general graduate/PG): Hostellers Rs.6,000 / Day Scholars Rs.3,000; Group 4 (post-matric non-degree): Hostellers Rs.4,000 / Day Scholars Rs.2,500; 10% extra for Divyang (PWD)
scheme.deadline: Rolling (portals open throughout the year; State/UTs may prescribe specific deadlines)

states: State/UT of domicile only (SC category as specified for that State/UT)
eligibility.years_of_study: Up to completion of the course subject to satisfactory academic performance and 75% attendance each year
eligibility.income_limit: Not to exceed Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees Two lakh Fifty thousand) during the last financial year

documents_required: Copies of certificates of previous examinations
Caste certificate duly signed by authorized officer
Valid income certificate issued by competent authority
Undertaking regarding institution charges and reimbursement
scheme.application_url: State/UT scholarship portal (or National Scholarship Portal)
scheme.how_to_apply: Student registers on the scholarship portal for a Freeship Card before admission; applies for the scholarship on the same day as admission date on the portal.
scheme.notes: Freeship Card issued for one year allows admission without pre-payment of fees. Payment via DBT only. Aadhaar authentication mandatory for renewals. Management quota/NRI/spot admission seats are not eligible. Attendance requirement: 75% per academic year.

reasons: Family income ₹1.8L is within the ₹2.5L limit
cautions: Extracted by the agent — verify on the official portal before applying
